---
title: Playback frames
---

# Playback frames

Each chart is read at another frame and at its first; the texts on the chart must be that frame's values.

```chart
type: bar
title: Values by year
data:
  inline:
    - {c: A, y: 7, year: "2000"}
    - {c: B, y: 3, year: "2000"}
    - {c: C, y: 47, year: "2000"}
    - {c: A, y: 8, year: "2001"}
    - {c: B, y: 2.95, year: "2001"}
    - {c: C, y: 50, year: "2001"}
encoding: {x: c, y: y}
controls:
  - kind: playback
    id: year
    field: year
    label: Year
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Stacked totals by year
stack: true
data:
  inline:
    - {year: "2000", k: A, s: P, v: 1.5}
    - {year: "2000", k: A, s: Q, v: 2.5}
    - {year: "2000", k: B, s: P, v: 2}
    - {year: "2000", k: B, s: Q, v: 8}
    - {year: "2001", k: A, s: P, v: 10}
    - {year: "2001", k: A, s: Q, v: 20}
    - {year: "2001", k: B, s: P, v: 30}
    - {year: "2001", k: B, s: Q, v: 40}
encoding: {x: k, y: v, color: s}
controls:
  - kind: playback
    id: year
    field: year
    label: Year
```
